settingHints.web.port: 0 uses default 8720; falls back to a random port if busy
settingHints.web.auto_open: Web build only; the desktop shell never opens a browser
settingHints.webdav.enabled: Turn on to mount with Explorer or rclone
settingHints.webdav.addr: host:port such as 127.0.0.1:8080; keep it on loopback
settingHints.webdav.volume: Empty means the first enabled volume
settingHints.mount.sync_seconds: 0 means 15s default, negative disables auto sync
settingHints.mount.download_parallel: One MTProto connection cannot saturate; about 4 is best
settingHints.mount.upload_parallel: Lower it on slow links to avoid FLOOD_WAIT
settingHints.mount.read_chunk_mb: Larger means fewer requests but worse on slow links
settingHints.pwa.enabled: When off, manifest and service worker are not served
settingHints.pwa.name: Shown in the browser install prompt
settingHints.log.level: debug logs every remote fetch; enable only while diagnosing
